#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import json
import re
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

pio.templates.default = "plotly_dark"

ROOT = Path("..")
if not (ROOT / "bench-results").exists():
    ROOT = Path(".")

_RE_KV_GIB = re.compile(r"Available KV cache memory:\s*([\d.]+)\s*GiB")
_RE_KV_TOKENS = re.compile(r"GPU KV cache size:\s*([\d,]+)\s*tokens")
_RE_KV_MAXCONC = re.compile(
    r"Maximum concurrency for\s*([\d,]+)\s*tokens per request:\s*([\d.]+)x"
)

RUN_COLORS = {
    "TP16": "#1f77b4",
    "TEP16": "#17becf",
    "TP8×PP2": "#ff7f0e",
    "TP8×DP2": "#2ca02c",
    "P/D": "#d62728",
}


def parse_kv_from_logs(data_dir: Path) -> dict:
    """Parse available KV GiB / token capacity from archived vllm-recipe-*.log files.

    Returns blank display strings when logs (or the KV lines) are missing so the
    overview table stays renderable before copy-sweep-results.sh lands the logs.
    """
    gibs: list[float] = []
    tokens = None
    max_conc = None
    ctx_tokens = None
    for path in sorted(data_dir.glob("vllm-recipe-*.log")):
        text = path.read_text(errors="replace")
        m_gib = _RE_KV_GIB.search(text)
        if m_gib:
            gibs.append(float(m_gib.group(1)))
        if tokens is None:
            m_tok = _RE_KV_TOKENS.search(text)
            if m_tok:
                tokens = int(m_tok.group(1).replace(",", ""))
        if max_conc is None:
            m_mc = _RE_KV_MAXCONC.search(text)
            if m_mc:
                ctx_tokens = int(m_mc.group(1).replace(",", ""))
                max_conc = float(m_mc.group(2))

    if not gibs:
        gib_s = "—"
    elif len(set(gibs)) == 1:
        gib_s = f"{gibs[0]:.2f} GiB"
    else:
        gib_s = " / ".join(f"{g:.2f} GiB" for g in gibs)

    if tokens is None:
        tok_s = "—"
    else:
        tok_s = f"{tokens:,} tokens"

    if max_conc is None or ctx_tokens is None:
        maxconc_s = "—"
    else:
        maxconc_s = f"{max_conc:.2f}× @ {ctx_tokens:,} tok"

    return {
        "kv_gib": gib_s,
        "kv_tokens": tok_s,
        "kv_max_concurrency": maxconc_s,
        "kv_gib_raw": gibs,
        "kv_tokens_raw": tokens,
    }


def load_sweep(data_dir: Path, label: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    paths = [
        p
        for p in data_dir.glob("conc-*.json")
        if p.stem.split("-")[1].isdigit() and "topup" not in p.name
    ]
    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda p: int(p.stem.split("-")[1])):
        d = json.loads(path.read_text())
        rows.append(
            {
                "run": label,
                "concurrency": d["max_concurrency"],
                "num_prompts": d["num_prompts"],
                "duration_s": d["duration"],
                "completed": d["completed"],
                "failed": d["failed"],
                "request_throughput": d["request_throughput"],
                "input_throughput": d["input_throughput"],
                "output_throughput": d["output_throughput"],
                "total_token_throughput": d["total_token_throughput"],
                "mean_ttft_ms": d["mean_ttft_ms"],
                "p90_ttft_ms": d["p90_ttft_ms"],
                "p99_ttft_ms": d["p99_ttft_ms"],
                "mean_tpot_ms": d["mean_tpot_ms"],
                "p90_tpot_ms": d["p90_tpot_ms"],
                "p99_tpot_ms": d["p99_tpot_ms"],
                "mean_itl_ms": d["mean_itl_ms"],
                "mean_e2el_ms": d["mean_e2el_ms"],
                "p90_e2el_ms": d["p90_e2el_ms"],
                "p99_e2el_ms": d["p99_e2el_ms"],
                "max_concurrent_requests": d.get("max_concurrent_requests"),
                "date": d.get("date"),
                "model_id": d.get("model_id"),
            }
        )
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("concurrency").reset_index(drop=True)
    tok1 = df.loc[df["concurrency"] == 1, "output_throughput"].iloc[0]
    df["ideal_output_tok_s"] = tok1 * df["concurrency"]
    df["scaling_efficiency"] = df["output_throughput"] / df["ideal_output_tok_s"]
    return df


tp16_dir = ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-real-1000-1000"
tep_dir = ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-tep-1000-1000"
pp2_dir = ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000"
dp2_dir = ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-dp2-1000-1000"
pd_dir = ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-pd-1000-1000"
df_tp16 = load_sweep(tp16_dir, "TP16")
df_tep = load_sweep(tep_dir, "TEP16")
df_pp2 = load_sweep(pp2_dir, "TP8×PP2")
df_dp2 = load_sweep(dp2_dir, "TP8×DP2")
df_pd = load_sweep(pd_dir, "P/D")
base_tp16 = df_tp16.loc[df_tp16["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]
base_tep = df_tep.loc[df_tep["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]
base_pp2 = df_pp2.loc[df_pp2["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]
base_dp2 = df_dp2.loc[df_dp2["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]
base_pd = df_pd.loc[df_pd["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]

tp16_seed = tp16_dir / "seed.txt"
tep_seed = tep_dir / "seed.txt"
pp2_seed = pp2_dir / "seed.txt"
dp2_seed = dp2_dir / "seed.txt"
pd_seed = pd_dir / "seed.txt"
TP16_SEED = tp16_seed.read_text().strip() if tp16_seed.exists() else "n/a"
TEP_SEED = tep_seed.read_text().strip() if tep_seed.exists() else "n/a"
PP2_SEED = pp2_seed.read_text().strip() if pp2_seed.exists() else "n/a"
DP2_SEED = dp2_seed.read_text().strip() if dp2_seed.exists() else "n/a"
PD_SEED = pd_seed.read_text().strip() if pd_seed.exists() else "n/a"

kv_tp16 = parse_kv_from_logs(tp16_dir)
kv_tep = parse_kv_from_logs(tep_dir)
kv_pp2 = parse_kv_from_logs(pp2_dir)
kv_dp2 = parse_kv_from_logs(dp2_dir)
kv_pd = parse_kv_from_logs(pd_dir)
TP16_KV_GIB = kv_tp16["kv_gib"]
TEP_KV_GIB = kv_tep["kv_gib"]
PP2_KV_GIB = kv_pp2["kv_gib"]
DP2_KV_GIB = kv_dp2["kv_gib"]
TP16_KV_TOKENS = kv_tp16["kv_tokens"]
TEP_KV_TOKENS = kv_tep["kv_tokens"]
PP2_KV_TOKENS = kv_pp2["kv_tokens"]
DP2_KV_TOKENS = kv_dp2["kv_tokens"]
TP16_KV_MAXCONC = kv_tp16["kv_max_concurrency"]
TEP_KV_MAXCONC = kv_tep["kv_max_concurrency"]
PP2_KV_MAXCONC = kv_pp2["kv_max_concurrency"]
DP2_KV_MAXCONC = kv_dp2["kv_max_concurrency"]
PD_KV_GIB = kv_pd["kv_gib"]
PD_KV_TOKENS = kv_pd["kv_tokens"]
PD_KV_MAXCONC = kv_pd["kv_max_concurrency"]

both = pd.concat([df_tp16, df_tep, df_pp2, df_dp2, df_pd], ignore_index=True)
# Wide table: intersection including DP2 (C≤16). Ratio charts use high-C shared below.
shared = sorted(
    set(df_tp16["concurrency"])
    & set(df_tep["concurrency"])
    & set(df_pp2["concurrency"])
    & set(df_dp2["concurrency"])
    & set(df_pd["concurrency"])
)
shared_hi = sorted(
    set(df_tp16["concurrency"])
    & set(df_tep["concurrency"])
    & set(df_pp2["concurrency"])
    & set(df_pd["concurrency"])
)
cmp_rows = []
for c in shared:
    t = df_tp16.loc[df_tp16["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    e = df_tep.loc[df_tep["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    p = df_pp2.loc[df_pp2["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    d = df_dp2.loc[df_dp2["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    pdx = df_pd.loc[df_pd["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    cmp_rows.append(
        {
            "concurrency": c,
            "tp16_tok_s": t["output_throughput"],
            "tep_tok_s": e["output_throughput"],
            "pp2_tok_s": p["output_throughput"],
            "dp2_tok_s": d["output_throughput"],
            "pd_tok_s": pdx["output_throughput"],
            "tep_tp16": e["output_throughput"] / t["output_throughput"],
            "pp2_tp16": p["output_throughput"] / t["output_throughput"],
            "dp2_tp16": d["output_throughput"] / t["output_throughput"],
            "pd_tp16": pdx["output_throughput"] / t["output_throughput"],
            "dp2_pp2": d["output_throughput"] / p["output_throughput"],
            "tp16_tpot": t["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "tep_tpot": e["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "pp2_tpot": p["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "dp2_tpot": d["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "pd_tpot": pdx["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "tp16_ttft": t["mean_ttft_ms"],
            "tep_ttft": e["mean_ttft_ms"],
            "pp2_ttft": p["mean_ttft_ms"],
            "dp2_ttft": d["mean_ttft_ms"],
            "pd_ttft": pdx["mean_ttft_ms"],
            "tp16_e2el_s": t["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000,
            "tep_e2el_s": e["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000,
            "pp2_e2el_s": p["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000,
            "dp2_e2el_s": d["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000,
            "pd_e2el_s": pdx["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000,
            "tp16_eff": t["scaling_efficiency"],
            "tep_eff": e["scaling_efficiency"],
            "pp2_eff": p["scaling_efficiency"],
            "dp2_eff": d["scaling_efficiency"],
            "pd_eff": pdx["scaling_efficiency"],
        }
    )
cmp = pd.DataFrame(cmp_rows)
cmp_hi_rows = []
for c in shared_hi:
    t = df_tp16.loc[df_tp16["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    e = df_tep.loc[df_tep["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    p = df_pp2.loc[df_pp2["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    pdx = df_pd.loc[df_pd["concurrency"] == c].iloc[0]
    cmp_hi_rows.append(
        {
            "concurrency": c,
            "tep_tp16": e["output_throughput"] / t["output_throughput"],
            "pp2_tp16": p["output_throughput"] / t["output_throughput"],
            "pd_tp16": pdx["output_throughput"] / t["output_throughput"],
        }
    )
cmp_hi = pd.DataFrame(cmp_hi_rows)
tep_tp16_c1 = cmp.loc[cmp["concurrency"] == 1, "tep_tp16"].iloc[0]
pp2_tp16_c1 = cmp.loc[cmp["concurrency"] == 1, "pp2_tp16"].iloc[0]
dp2_tp16_c1 = cmp.loc[cmp["concurrency"] == 1, "dp2_tp16"].iloc[0]
pd_tp16_c1 = cmp.loc[cmp["concurrency"] == 1, "pd_tp16"].iloc[0]
peak_tp16 = df_tp16.loc[df_tp16["output_throughput"].idxmax()]
peak_tep = df_tep.loc[df_tep["output_throughput"].idxmax()]
peak_pp2 = df_pp2.loc[df_pp2["output_throughput"].idxmax()]
peak_dp2 = df_dp2.loc[df_dp2["output_throughput"].idxmax()]
peak_pd = df_pd.loc[df_pd["output_throughput"].idxmax()]

# Introduction

Evaluate the deployment strategies listed on the official
[vLLM Kimi-K3 recipe](https://recipes.vllm.ai/moonshotai/Kimi-K3)
on H200 with the MXFP4 checkpoint. Compare the various
parallelization strategies under a simple vllm bench workload (**1000 in / 1000 out**).
The 5 selectable strategies are: TP/TEP/PP/DP on **2×8** (16 GPUs) and
P/D on the recipe **4×8** layout (32 GPUs). 

```{python}
#| label: intro-outcome
#| output: asis
print(f"""
**Outcome (brief):**

- **PP2 is the throughput leader among 16-GPU strategies** — peak
  **{peak_pp2['output_throughput']:.0f}** tok/s @C={int(peak_pp2['concurrency'])},
  vs TP16 **{peak_tp16['output_throughput']:.0f}** @C={int(peak_tp16['concurrency'])}
  and TEP16 **{peak_tep['output_throughput']:.0f}** @C={int(peak_tep['concurrency'])}
- **DP2 saturates early** (~**{peak_dp2['output_throughput']:.0f}** tok/s) — H200 KV fits
  ~1 in-flight 1000/1000 request per replica, so extra concurrency beyond C≈4 does not help.
- **P/D on 4×8 is KV-limited** (~**{peak_pd['output_throughput']:.0f}** tok/s) despite 2×
  the GPU count of the other strategies; treat it as a different capacity class, not a
  direct 16-GPU comparison.
""")
```

## Recipe strategy coverage

From the [Kimi-K3 recipe](https://recipes.vllm.ai/moonshotai/Kimi-K3) Strategy picker (page defaults to **NVIDIA H200**). 

| Recipe strategy | Recipe id | Recipe intent (from page) | H200 recipe UI | This report | Harness shorthand |
|-----------------|-----------|---------------------------|----------------|-------------|-------------------|
| [Multi-Node Tensor Parallel](https://recipes.vllm.ai/moonshotai/Kimi-K3?strategy=multi_node_tp) | `multi_node_tp` | Latency-oriented; TP = total GPUs across nodes; `--headless` workers | Selectable | **Measured** (C=1…512) | TP16 |
| [Multi-Node Tensor + Expert Parallel](https://recipes.vllm.ai/moonshotai/Kimi-K3?strategy=multi_node_tep) | `multi_node_tep` | Balanced; cross-node TP + `--enable-expert-parallel` | Selectable | **Measured** (C=1…512) | TEP16 |
| [Multi-Node TP + Pipeline Parallel](https://recipes.vllm.ai/moonshotai/Kimi-K3?strategy=multi_node_tp_pp) | `multi_node_tp_pp` | Throughput; TP in-node, PP across nodes | Selectable | **Measured** (C=1…512) | TP8×PP2 |
| Multi-Node Data + Expert Parallel | `multi_node_dep` | Throughput; per-node TEP + DP across nodes (`--enable-expert-parallel`, `--data-parallel-hybrid-lb`) | **Unsupported** (greyed out) | Out of scope on H200 | — |
| [Multi-Node TP + Data Parallel](https://recipes.vllm.ai/moonshotai/Kimi-K3?strategy=multi_node_tp_dp) | `multi_node_tp_dp` | Balanced; one full replica / node (e.g. TP8·DP2) | Selectable | **Measured** (C=1…16) | TP8×DP2 |
| [Prefill/Decode Disaggregation](https://recipes.vllm.ai/moonshotai/Kimi-K3?strategy=pd_cluster) | `pd_cluster` | Production; separate prefill/decode + NIXL KV transfer | Selectable | **Measured** (C=1…512) on **4×8 H200** | P/D |

Comparison charts below cover the **five measured** selectable strategies (TP/TEP/PP/DP on 2×8; P/D on 4×8). `multi_node_dep` remains out of scope on H200. P/D peak throughput is **not** apples-to-apples with the 16-GPU strategies — it uses twice the GPU count.

# Configuration

Same MXFP4 checkpoint (`/models/Kimi-K3` on hostPath), same prompt shape (**1000 in / 1000 out**, `--ignore-eos`, `--request-rate inf`). TP16 / TEP16 / PP2 / P/D cover C ∈ {1…512}; DP2 stops at C ∈ {1…16} — KV-limited (~1 req/replica), so throughput already plateaus by C=4. Flags from each sweep’s archived `vllm-recipe-*.log` (`non-default args` / launch banner). | Data | [`conc-sweep-real-1000-1000/`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/tree/main/bench-results/conc-sweep-real-1000-1000) | [`conc-sweep-tep-1000-1000/`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/tree/main/bench-results/conc-sweep-tep-1000-1000) | [`conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000/`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/tree/main/bench-results/conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000) | [`conc-sweep-dp2-1000-1000/`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/tree/main/bench-results/conc-sweep-dp2-1000-1000) | [`conc-sweep-pd-1000-1000/`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/tree/main/bench-results/conc-sweep-pd-1000-1000) |

- **TEP16:** same knobs as TP16 plus `--enable-expert-parallel` (same `nnodes` / `node-rank` path).
- **DP2:** on H200 a TP8 replica is ~135.7 GiB/GPU (vs ~129.8 GiB under TP16/TEP16), so it needs the differing knobs above (`--skip-mm-profiling`, 64 MiB FlashInfer workspace, tiny batched/KV). Recipe target hardware is GB300; DP2 1000/1000 fits ~1 concurrent request/replica (~2 cluster-wide).
- **PP2:** cross-node P2P required the IPv4-mapped RoCE GID (`NCCL_IB_*`).
- **P/D:** recipe 4×8 layout (TEP16 prefill on pods 0–1, TEP16 decode on pods 2–3, router on `:8000`); KV-limited (~1.66 GiB prefill / ~2.19 GiB decode per worker, max concurrency ~6.72× @ 8192, prefill `--max-num-seqs 5`) — plateaus ~229 tok/s from C≈16. Requires `VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT=DS` for hybrid Mamba KV transfer.

```{python}
#| label: method-meta
def _tiers_line(name: str, df, base) -> str:
    tiers = str(list(df["concurrency"]))
    return f"{name:<5} tiers: {tiers:<44}  |  C=1 = {base['output_throughput']:.1f} tok/s"

print(
    "\n".join(
        [
            _tiers_line("TP16", df_tp16, base_tp16),
            _tiers_line("TEP", df_tep, base_tep),
            _tiers_line("PP2", df_pp2, base_pp2),
            _tiers_line("DP2", df_dp2, base_dp2),
            _tiers_line("P/D", df_pd, base_pd),
        ]
    )
)
```

for col in (1, 2):

# Per-config detail

```{python}
#| label: detail-table-helper

def per_config_table(df):
    show = df[
        [
            "concurrency",
            "num_prompts",
            "duration_s",
            "request_throughput",
            "output_throughput",
            "mean_ttft_ms",
            "mean_tpot_ms",
            "mean_e2el_ms",
        ]
    ].copy()
    show["concurrency"] = show["concurrency"].astype(int)
    show["num_prompts"] = show["num_prompts"].astype(int)
    show["duration_s"] = show["duration_s"].round(1)
    show["request_throughput"] = show["request_throughput"].round(1)
    show["output_throughput"] = show["output_throughput"].round(1)
    show["mean_ttft_ms"] = show["mean_ttft_ms"].round(1)
    show["mean_tpot_ms"] = show["mean_tpot_ms"].round(1)
    show["mean_e2el_ms"] = (show["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000).round(1)
    show = show.rename(
        columns={
            "concurrency": "C",
            "num_prompts": "prompts",
            "duration_s": "dur (s)",
            "request_throughput": "req/s",
            "output_throughput": "out tok/s",
            "mean_ttft_ms": "TTFT ms",
            "mean_tpot_ms": "TPOT ms",
            "mean_e2el_ms": "E2EL s",
        }
    )
    return show.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "C": "{:d}",
            "prompts": "{:d}",
            "dur (s)": "{:.1f}",
            "req/s": "{:.1f}",
            "out tok/s": "{:.1f}",
            "TTFT ms": "{:.1f}",
            "TPOT ms": "{:.1f}",
            "E2EL s": "{:.1f}",
        }
    )
```

# Torch profiles

Note: these are *not* profiles for performance analysis, these are just small profiles to understand the kernels being used. They use just 4 hidden layers (every 4th layer is MLA, the rest are KDA), 32 experts, and dummy weights. All the traces are for a 10 token prompt and 5 tokens output. Links open rank-0 **TP0** Chrome traces in [Perfetto UI](https://ui.perfetto.dev/).
